rule: ALIVE iff >= 2 adjacent ring gains with lower 95% CI of Delta_SM and Delta_acc_vg > 0 (pareto_interp) and the ring's sw time off target non-inferior to both tuned rivals (upper 95% CI of ring - rival < 0.5 s); DEAD iff SM or accumulator_vg Delta <= 0 wherever defined (dominance frontier if pareto_interp undefined at every gain); else INCONCLUSIVE

secondary_3d_dominance.label: Amendment A7.1, fixed before any test seed after seeing training-seed tuning data: descriptive, not a gate. A ring point is dominated by a rival if some rival point (sweep or tuned) has hold >=, release <= and time off target <= with one strict
